concept.signature_decision: The carrier is the sole signature component: an integral round matte-black field with two logarithmic seven-gear chains, intended to read as an accretion disc around the real open orange-backed core. Added actual gear coverage is distinct from backing area. Independent recognition review remains pending; this is an invented sculpture,not a historical reconstruction.
concept.summary: A hand-spun black-hole desk sculpture: two seven-gear logarithmic brass chains orbit a fixed spiral-spoked sun around a true14mm through-hole and passive orange core. An integral188mm matte-black annular carrier field gives a round dark background; additional actual gears extend each arm beyond180degrees. Seven gears per arm invoke the explicit fewer/larger fallback; fresh dense-disc recognition remains pending.
